EDEMA\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis is an online e-log platform to discuss case scenario of a patient with their guardians permission.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of patient clinical data analysis to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;CHIEF COMPLAINT:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 65 years old male patient ,resident of suryapet ,mason by occupation,came to the casualty with chief complaint of shortness of breath since 5 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDistension of abdomen and pedal edema since 1 week.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-\u0026gt;patient was apparently asymptomatic 1year back then she has\u0026nbsp; shortness of breath, pedal edema, distension of abdomen.She went to a local hospital and was diagnosed with renal failure and heart failure.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E7 months back\u0026nbsp; patient had similar episodes and had Hb of 6 approx and 20 prbc and transfusion was done\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ediagnosed as anemia secondary to CKD\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENO H\/O of hematemesis, decreased apetite\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E-\u0026gt;1 week back-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eshortness of breath which is insidious in onset,\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eorthopnea+\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eno h\/o PND, no h\/o wheezing\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Echest pain occasionally present which is radiating to arms, relieved after taking medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Edistension of abdomen- 2 months\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Edecreased urine output, appetite is normal, burning micturition, pedal edema since 3 months, piiting type and increased while standing also.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PAST ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot a k\/c\/o TB, asthma, months.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E•\u003Cb\u003EHistory of present illness:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1yr back then she noticed decreased\u0026nbsp; urine output.She went to a local hospital and was diagnosed as renal failure and heart failure and was on treatment.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThen 3months back she noticed increased Bilateral pedal edema -pitting type, extending till ankles .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eshortness of breath\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient visited a local hospital where she has undergone 2 dialysis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThen 10 days back she visited our hospital where she has undergone 2 dialysis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient complained of pain in back of shoulder due to which sleep is inadequate.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of burning micturition, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea,cough, cold, 19 yr old male with fever and bodypains"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;This is an E log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his guardian sign informed consent. Here we discuss our patient's clinical problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve the problem with collective current best evidence based inputs. This E log also reflect my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on comment box.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 19 year old male patient came to OPD with the chief complaint of fever since 1 week.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHOPI\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1 week back then he developed fever with chills which is high grade , sudden in onset and associated with bodypains. Relieved on medication.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2 days back he was taken to outside hospital, there his platelet count was 129000 cells\/mm3, yesterday count was 132000 cells\/cumm and today count is 98000cells\/cumm.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o loose stools, vomitings\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o hematuria, dark stools\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o pain abdomen, giddiness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPAST HISTORY\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a k\/c\/o hypertension,dm, thyroid, epilepsy\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet: mixed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite: normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep: adequate\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and bladder movements: normal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is conscious coherent cooperative well oriented to time place and person.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EModerately built and moderately nourished.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo pallor, cyanosis, icterus, lymphadenopathy.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBP - 90\/60 mmHg\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPr -84\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERR - 14cpm\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESpo2-99\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETemperature -99.5 F\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECVS - S1 S2 +\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECNS- - NAD\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERS - BAE +\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EP\/A - soft, non tender\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
